changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE supplier_bill ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinic(id), supplier_id BIGINT REFERENCES supplier(id), bill_number VARCHAR(100), bill_date DATE NOT NULL, due_date DATE, total_amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL, paid_amount NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNPAID', notes TEXT, attachment_path VARCHAR(512), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() )
